text: Great game, encourages exersise, but a couple of minor annoyances are; that it takes so long to confirm the catching of a pokemon in a ball, 3 seconds is a lot when you're walking. Raid bosses can be impossible unless you have a Large group of friends, Facebook groups have helped to a small degree. And my main gripe, is the way pokemon are displayed in gyms. Please sort them so that biggest go at the back and smaller at the front, or all in a row. Other than those peeves, it's good fun.

From Hero to Zero. The game started off great, loved catching, evolving and trading Pokemon. However the latest update won't even let me open the app. It crashes every time, even after I uninstalled and reinstalled it. Still won't work. So now I have made the decision to delete it forever and move onto Digimon or Dragon Quest, which apps open regardless of updates.

Less microtransactions and just removing stardust altogether would make it near perfect. Also, being able to exchange excess candy for items would be a nice addition. **review amended for 2026** Uninstalled the game after learning of data scraping for GPS AI training. Pokémon branding has been used to mask what the app was actually doing behind the scenes with user data. Yo say I am disgusted is an understatement.

Loved this back in the day, but my previous views on the game have been tarnished after coming back recently. The game is fun until you run out of Pokémon storage space and Pokéballs (I know you can go to Pokéstops, but they mainly just give you incense). Not a bad game, but not one I'd be able to invest myself in again.

Played it on release and for years after. Game is awful now. Too many micro transactions and pay walls. Used to be A 5 star review but updating to be more in line with the current game. Considering the target audience is children this predatory style of play is disgusting. Somewhere along the way the ideology of Pokémon was lost. It's supposed to be a fun monster capturing game, not a money driven slopfest.

The bottom half of the screen stops working meaning I can't use charged attacks when fighting after the first use, can't tell how many fights I've lost and had to use valuable items because of this glitch! now a route I've made has been declined because of being 'inaccessible', yet I've literally walked it with wheelchairs, unlike my usual route that starts at the top of 30 stone steps...

PoGo is a deeply flawed as a game for many reasons that most people have covered here, but(!) It's perhaps the only game to recapture the sense of adventure and wonder we had as children. It feels like secrets are behind every corner and there's a whole world to explore. Playing this game has frustrated me no end with all the bugs and problems, but through it all it has also made me extremely happy and I've met many great people along the way. I thoroughly recommend it.

The constant updates are very inconvenient and seem a bit unnecessary. I don't know about anyone else, but since this game takes up quite a lot of space, updating it is a huge hassle that usually prevents me from playing the game for a while, since I have to delete other apps in order to make room for the update. I would prefer larger updates that happen occasionally, rather than one every week.

I've been playing this game for a while and enjoying it, despite it being exceptionally buggy. Frequently, I would just be logged out and I'd have to jump through a bunch of hoops (such as deleting cache) in order to log back in. Whenever it needed an update I would actually need to delete and reinstall it. On its most recent update I can't even reinstall it. This is preposterously broken.

Really good game, but I can't do much where I am due to the lack of other players in this area, making it virtually impossible so continue, not only this but raising the prices of everything in the item shop is just ridiculous, the remote raid passes in particular, I feel 150 or 120 would be better than 195. However, when you have other players, it is very fun. One thing though, is it crashes way too much

Good game if you're a pokemon fan, otherwise I'd be less confident recommending it. The game is somewhat past it's prime, both in terms of popularity (summer 2016) and ideal player experience (the company is actively rolling back improvements made during 2020 which aid rural and remote play because they can't sell as much data if you have to walk around less). It's still enjoyable if you did enjoy it in it's prime, but I don't know a lot of people who have stuck with it.

I love this game, been playing since it came to the UK. However certain things are really starting to annoy me, for example, pokemon with incredibly low CP are somehow able to break out of ultra balls many times! Also, when battling, there should be an option to decline the mystery pokemon that you win. I've just used 60 pokeballs trying to catch one, all of my berries, multiple ultra balls and all of my great balls and STILL I haven't caught it! And I cant battle again till I've got it!

Edit 07/11/2018: the individual pokemon pages keeps crashing and there's no way to return to the pokemon bag view without exiting the game completely. Whilst it crashes, the favourite and appraise options, etc still work. __________ The app has come a long way. Game play is now a lot better and there are way more features. This game actually encourages me to go outside and go on walks. I do wish that more of the original 151 Pokemons will appear as these are the ones I'm familiar with from my childhood. Edit: after the recent update I have found that Pokemons break free a lot more frequently. For instance I might have had several good shots capturing the pokemon everytime but one has literally broken free more than 5 times. This is frustrating as it's too time consuming for one pokemon and depletes the pokeballs supply very quickly.

Enjoyable if you're out and about a lot. Game sometimes hangs when you click on a wild pokemon- requiring you to restart the game and lose the pokemon you were just trying to catch. The AR scan task is quite irritating, particularly if you don't have access to get exactly where the marker is. Even when you can- I've stood on an AR gym many times and it still tells me to get closer to scan it, though there was physically no way for me to get on top of it more than I already was.

The game is fun to play, when it works. Every time I've played this game it's bugged out in some way, whether it's the pokeball not shaking when trying to catch a pokemon, or when a pokemon escapes from the ball but it doesn't zoom back out for me try throwing another one, both meaning I have to restart the app. Then usually after that it says I'm unable to log in. And that farce continues for a good couple of hours sometimes until I can eventually log back in again. Basically, it needs a load of patches...

So much potential wasted. Niantic was responsible for the first thing humanity came to world peace, yet they failed. I've played the game since it's launch and even though it was always littered with bugs, but it was okay because it was fun. They managed to improve the game even more during the pandemic, making the game more accessible to the less able. After that it all went downhill. They slowly removed or limited every good new feature. Last straw was doubling the prices in the in game shop.

I played this game for years now and im starting to enjoy it less ans less, simply because, with the recent update, Niantic are refusing to take into consideration players that either cant attend in person rais due to personal difficulties, or simply not having a large enough local community to deal with harder content, such as legendary and mega raids. However if this huge part of the game is to be overlooked, its still a pretty good game, but still, not as inclusive as it was and should be.

No help or tutorial at the start was dumb. And finding Pokémon takes forever, Thanks to the fact I don't live in a city. Great idea on straight up abandoning the countryside. Plus getting pokeballs is dumb, I get one or two from a stop. Should be given way more than that to be considered long term playable without paying which is clearly its main focus... I jump in and out but it's mostly just garbage and something to do for no real reason.

The game itself is great fun. Very well thought and gets more and more features. Regular events and a very nice community around it. The implementation on the other hand is poor at best. The game is full of bugs, kicking you out of raid battles for no good reason, errors out in the middle of anything. They obviously make a lot of money on the in-game purchases, I don't really get how they can low-ball their infrastructure.

Updated from my previous review (from 2016: 4 -> 3 stars). The gameplay has got more fun, and the previous issues are resolved. However the game is becoming more pay-to-play than it used to be. You now have to buy some special researches (not using the in game currency), and it is harder than ever to earn in game currency. It takes 3 days of acquiring the maximum daily coins in order to afford a single incubator, which is virtually impossible as it requires other people to beat your gyms daily.

I spend far too much time on this game. Following the most recent update, however, this is likely to change. The buddy section no longer loads, meaning that it will take longer to upgrade and will also deny "gifts" that it brings. It was bad enough that you decided that we couldn't play long distance raids, but this is ridiculous. Kinda defeats the object when you can't play the whole game. Thumbs down, Niantic.

2016 Very addictive. I can't log in half the time but when I can I can't fault the game. My dogs never been walked so much. New review. 2022 still playing on and off. My son is into it now. Sadly though I can't seem to upload pokestop scans, it just crashes and the adventure sync doesn't work for either of us. Other then that. Brilliant game. X

I am really enjoying the game and would love to give it a good rating, but I am constantly getting issues, crashing, freezing up and graphical issues too. These are all things that I can work around as they don't stop my progress. But the main issue I have, is Pokémon in gyms, they will be in there for 12 or more hours, get knocked then get knocked out. I'll get the notification to get pokecoins, but when I look, I haven't received any, this has happened a lot of times it's stopping me raiding.

There are many issues that compromise the fundamental enjoyment of the game. There needs to be some sort of tracking. It doesn't have to be a specific location but at least bring something in that allows you to know if you're getting close or too far away. Lack of variety of pokemon spawning in rural areas is an issue. The gym update means anyone can take a gym. The new buddy system is an attempt to stop you hoarding useful berries and getting rare candies more easily.

The game is great in general but I've found a few fundamental issues with trading that could be improved. There is no warning in game that you cannot trade back your Pokémon, therefore causing me to lose one of my best ones when attempting to get a lucky Pokémon. This is poor game design and user experience. This could be solved by allowing trade backs, with possibly a cool down of 30 days so as to not take advantage. Also needs a popup warning before confirming trade.

I've played this since it was released officially in the UK. Since then, it's gained so many features that are fundamental to Pokemon, that it is essentially a fully fledged Pokemon game in its own right, rather than a quick money grabber. It occasionally suffers reliability issues but those tend to get resolved soon after, and it's adapted well to lockdown measures from COVID. Overall, if you like Pokémon, there's no reason to miss out on playing this.

I've been playing this a lot, while partaking in my daily walks out and about the neighborhood. I've not been a Pokefan much in the past but really feel like this game rewards you for getting out and doing some exercise. Like the Ingress game it's based on, there's strategic locations around your neighborhood you can visit to find resources, that you can use to capture Pokémon and to improve the ones you have. You don't have to fight other people if you don't want to either, which is nice.

Downloaded this game in 2016 and played it all the time. After a while I uninstalled it as it didn't appeal to me as much. Yet here I am in 2021 writing a review. As you can probably already tell by this review I have reinstalled it recently and I must say, the game has not lost its touch. There are several new features and updates I never imagined would be part of Pokémon go and there are still so many things to do. Also my progress was not deleted despite a 4-5 year break. 5 stars 100%.

Great game. I love finding Pokémon, catching them and occasionally trying to beat a gym or raid. It's fun to play with my friends and we can trade, send gifts and even battle! However, it would be cool to add a feature where (if the player allows it) you can see if friends are online and maybe where they are so you can meet and play together. I think another good feature would be a messaging system so you can message friends who are online to ask to meet or trade etc.

Game is improving, as the "pay to win" feel at the same time. It will be interesting to see what happens next after the introduction of gen3. Battle, gyms and raiding system dynamics are incredibly simple and in desperate need of some depth. The weather influence was a good addition, but abilities will be needed at a certain point (i.e. soon). 95% of the pokemons are currently mere dex fillers with no actual use in the battle metagame.

Garbage, works purely on addiction factor and constant events trying to pull you in due to fear of missing something rare. Very little actual gameplay and mostly just going around hoping to get lucky. Loves to waste your time by making you spend 3-5 minutes tapping the screen in one place to "fight" a raid, then makes the catch rate so low you'll probably not catch the thing afterwards anyway. I'm giving it an extra star because the Pokémon are cute.

I think its good. Quite a good game to do while going out for minutes then going back home to stay in quarantine. But issues is lately. I had duplicates of the same pokémon in the area. Could try and make it so its less the same. And also hand out some codes so people can use them for items. Never be greedy for cash if we all stuck inside.

I've been playing since the beginning (2016). The game has tons of bugs and glitches, predatory pricing for in game items, a high focus on in real life experiences that are costly and unplayable due to bugs and server issues. On top of that, Niantic lately is removing game play options like it by the community, leaving behind a disappointed and unheard community. I won’t recommend you to download the game until Niantic resolve core issues with the game.

Unfortunately I give up on playing because it turned too messy, there is no tools enough to manage the Pokémons, checking, comparing before release and clean the boxes, you actually have to open one by one to check their status, and nobody has time for it anymore. The lack of simple tools are impressive. And I'm sure this are in proposed because they try you to buy more and more storage.

I've been playing this since 2016 and is the only mobile game I've ever truly enjoyed playing and have used for longer than a year. I'll admit, I'm a bit of a sucker for Pokemon, considering it was my first ever video game with Yellow back in 1999/2000. But the mechanics of the game when released was a massive bit of fresh air for the franchise and gave a new challenge to play. Research tasks, trainer xp, legendary raids, gyms, battling, new gens released each year. ABSOLUTELY ADDICTIVE 5*

The main point of the game, the Adventure Sync, breaks constantly and none of their solutions work. It won't even let you turn ON the Adventure Sync even when you've granted all the relevant permissions, it's not a problem of the user not granting the right settings, it's the app just being broken. It literally WILL NOT LET YOU and sometimes it won't even let you log on. I don't know what's happened but this game is becoming rapidly unplayable

I started to experience difficulties loading the game, kept getting a red bar at the top of the screen, telling me it could not find GPS signal. I have a brand new phone and have installed the latest Pokemon version from play store. Niantic.support gave me instructions to help correct the problem, nothing worked, so now unable to access the game.

I have been playing PGO since launch, despite a rocky start, I have had an excellent experience playing this game. only complaint would be raids. As great an idea as they are, it forces those who play alone to play with others to get certain pokemon. Despite some of these pokemon being available through research tasks later on in the game, it doesn't provide a great experience for those who prefer to play alone.

Interesting game with serious flaws due to extremely uneven distribution of stops and gyms. It's discouraging to play this game in Africa. There are hardly any pokestops, even in capital cities. The nearest gym is over 300 km away. The wayfarer system doesn't offer a solution either; proposals can be made but nothing happens in a year or more. Very disappointing

l absolutely loved this game as I've always loved pokemon, however, i wished there were more variations of skills. It becomes very repetitive and can become quite dull at times, if there was more to the game than just walking around and battling (such as style options) then it would be far more enjoyable in my opinion. Regardless though, it is a very good game with a lot of depth.

I hate leaving this game a bad review, but I'm hear again:(. First of all since the new update I drift a lot. I'm never where I'm supposed to be witch is annoying when I'm right by a gym ect and it's saying I'm across the road or out of range. The steps counter is still not reading properly. I did 27 mile the other day and it didn't read 15 of those miles. I've also noticed that it doesn't always register tasks e.g. hatch 5 eggs, make a great throw ect and I'll have to do them until it does.

Been playing this game a lot more recently and it's safe to say, I love it. I'm finding a bigger variety of pokemon now in the same places I used to find purely Ratatas and Pidgeys. Game used to crash, freeze and loose connection all the time but now I've noticed it is so much better! I've not had the game freeze on me while I'm trying to catch a pokemon since the summer when it first came out. Love the buddy feature as it enables me to only have to find one (dratini) to be able to get more candies for it.

This game hasn't changed in the nearly 10 years it's been out. Think how outdated some of the mechanics are after nearly a decade! Everything 'new' Niantic implements is a reskin of something they've done before. Plus the money grabbing that's become so prevalent in the last couple years. Niantic are one of laziest, greediest developers in the field- they'd be right at home with EA...

Loving playing this so far. Would be good if you could use a pokemon assigned to a gym to view the gym when youre out of range. (edit- they added this) Also friends, (edit- added) pvp (edit- also added)and fix the tracking. (edit- yea...sort of) I want to be able to find the pokemon nearby instead of wandering randomly till i find it. Overall im gonna be playing more. I like the walking im doing and its something else to drag my boyfriend out into the day star.

As a concept I think this is brilliant, having Pokemon overlaid on the real world is a neat idea. My kids love playing it and big bonus is they are getting outdoors, along with hundreds of others, I have even registered my own account. Bug fixes / updates are reasonably frequent. Still playing 4 years on, my kids have given up but it makes a daily walk a bit more interesting and some catches have become souvenirs of my travels.

Been playing this for some time now, they keep adding things to make you come back to it although the last month has been a little slow. The major floor I have found being someone who doesn't know very many people around me who play the game that it is going to be and has been impossible for me to complete tasks and pokedex when I cant battle 5 star raids as 1 or 2 people. Feels a bit unfair for those that are less social than others...

A really fun casual game, but its unfortunate how difficult some raids are as you can only beat them with other people, which can be difficult if you don't know anyone to play with or live in a small area with not a lot of other players. General gameplay is fun still and the more popular raids can be joined remotely so there is still the opportunity to beat them.

A really fun game to play. I like it so much! 5 stars 😀 edit: I think Niantic needs to start working on fixing some bugs, but even if they don't fix them for a long time, I still will have this review 5 stars because it's always a fun game to play. Pokemon Go is the best! 👍👍👍 Also here are a few suggestions: 1. Add pokestops in rural areas. 2. Add more characters for tags.

Gameplay is still fresh for the most part. A few questionable decisions quite a bit (example) research breakthrough = Trapinch.... Right after Trapinch was an event day with shinies quite common. Love the effort made to keep the game fun during lockdown. Keep up the good work, I look forward to the latest updates as the game expands further.

Still enjoyable but certainly needs a lot of quality of life updates. Having to perpetually buy bag and Pokémon storage is a chore, you should be able to still swipe pokestops for the xp even if your bag is full. The 50 coins a day limit is too little, 100 would be ideal. The variety in Pokémon in the wild still isn't great. Limitations on trading is unfair and the inability to do anything with friends far away is restricting, especially when you can't complete the Pokédex if you can't travel.

In-app purchases have risen by 95%. Makes daylight robbery seem attractive. Been playing this game since its release date and have never witnessed anything like this before. Penalising the mobility challenged community even more by limiting what they can and cant do in a game... A GAME!!!! Nope. No more for me, done with Niantic and their greedy ways.

It would be five stars if there wasn't a major glitch in the game that is becoming increasingly frustrating. Whenever I click on a pokemon to initiate a battle (usually rarer mons) I get presented with just a white screen, and then I can't catch pokemon for a couple of hours after because all I get is a white screen. It used to be every so often, and I didn't really mind, but bow it's almost every time I try and use the app.

I've thoroughly enjoyed this game I've even spent quite a bit of real money on it but the only thing that's bugging me is that since the raid battles became existent. I haven't been able to fight the pokemon. It loads and the countdown happens but as soon as it hits zero there's a connection error and I've missed out on legendary and equally rare pokemon alike.

A few issues, 1) when I try to catch a pokemon sometimes it doesn't allow me to use any ball to catch it. This has become a fairly regular thing where restarting the game is the only way to sort it and I miss out on the pokemon. 2) a similar problem where sometimes when I join a raid it doesn't actually let me battle so I can take damage but can't attack them myself. This has led to missing out on catching some good pokemon and losing my raid passes too. Please sort it out.

Played since day one, from the get go it was obvious Niantic built this game to be a cash cow and they never cared. At a certain point the game gets extremely repetitive and the amount of content - very limited. It feels like there is no point to waste weeks getting a pokemon that's 1% better. And for what? Hackers can do the same in minutes.

It's a great game, although it does have a few issues. 1. Just recently I haven't received any coins from defending gyms, even though one was for over a week. 2. The fact that some of the pokemon are region specific is a joke, it makes it pretty much impossible to collect every single one unless you have a ton of money and spare time, or you own your own plane. 3. Vary the pokemon that appear from time to time, it's always the same ones you see. I still haven't even seen a bulbasaur, despite visiting forests and fields!

So.... Firstly it's a great game and I love it as a long standing pokemon fan! It's so fun to play and great to get you out of the house more. You can also play WITHOUT having to make any online purchases which is fantastic as some games are almost impossible to play without spending real hard earned cash! It's really thought out , maybe a few lag issues here and there but I do have an older model phone and it still works really well. Overall, Great Job!

The game has changed from what it once was. That's not always a bad thing but in this instance this game has some poor and pay to win features. Collecting, raiding and catching Pokémon is fun. That core is always there and makes for a fun game. That said, the pricing of items with in the game do not make you feel like you are getting your money worth. Then there's the paid events that have also had major issues and their response to those issues have been poor. 2/10

Honestly, this game has become virtually unplayable recently. Each update brings more and more issues and errors. Crashing and freezing while trying to send gifts, lagging out after I've caught or evolved something meaning evolving with lucky egg is a no go, most recently it won't let me incubate eggs, constant errors during the current event such as not being able to log in for periods of time or pokemon vanishing when you click on them. Stop adding new stuff when you can't even fix existing errors!

Edit. 22/04/2021. I've played Pokemon Go since the very beginning, and I must say it's the best free game out there. Yes I have purchased coins in the past, but if I'm honest, that was just me not being patient enough to earn the 50 coins per day! It doesn't use much data to play. And the games GPS is pretty good also. You do get occasional glitches and bugs but they're soon eradicated with updates. Great game.

A great Pokemon game that gets you out and about. In fact Pokemon fans have been waiting for this type of game for a while. The GPS can be a little awkward though which upsets the flow of the game. the growing Pokédex is brilliant and mini missions keep it interesting. New Let's Go implementation is a little confusing to set up but once it is, trading Pokémon to your Switch is a really nice touch and very useful.

Makers seem to be doing all they can to frustrate players. If they want to shut down tracking sites the least they could do is fix the in-game tracking first. Nobody likes wandering aimlessly for hours not being able to tell if they're getting closer to a rare Pokemon or not. Also the levelling up thing seems so poorly thought out it's unbelievable, player levelling up and training Pokemon. Won't be spending any more on in app purchases until Niantic start listening to and communicating with fans.

Not a lot of fun to be found 'hunting' pokemon unless you use a 3rd party app in tandem. The lack of variety of pokemon being found is turning me off the game very quickly. Until niantic sort out the hacks, cheats and spoofing, especially when it comes to gyms, this game is essentially tedious, boring and broken and completely ruined for genuine players.

Much has improved over the last couple of years. pvp, shiny/lucky 'mon, field/special research, raids, events... etc... still a long way to go than just button mashing but dev's are clearly focusing on the main aim of pokemon; battling 'mon against other trainers. Still plenty of bugs in game, eg; vanishing pokemon, caught pokemon changing, freezing, crashing, amongst others (don't get me started on adventure sync!!!) but a vast improvement and I'm happy playing again

Quite entertaining...when it works. The game is pretty good, but has a habit of kicking you out and not being able to reconnect to the server. The only solution I've found is to uninstall it completely and then reinstall. As this is getting old very quickly, (and the reason I stopped playing for over a year previously), I can't see me doing it much longer. This longstanding login issue needs to be fixed.

It wont let me log in for days on end. Occasionally i get to uninstall it and reinstall and it'll work again, but it doesnt always fix it. Incredibly annoying when you're out and about I've tried contacting support multiple times for the past few months but noone ever replies. Very disappointed, i enjoy the game but it literally won't let me play it.

Its a good game. Adventure sync got me playing it again, but it doesn't always work. Also, as of late, every time I've loaded the game for the past few weeks, I've had the same 'GPS Signal not found' error, and just so you know, my location is turned on. Not sure if my device is incompatible, or if the GPS signal is just buggy 100% of the time. I can still battle and do the other non-gps signal related things. Sometimes spontaneously crashes, but I put that down to my phone, and not the game.

Little update on my old review. Was 3, now 2. There's been an uprising in errors for myself and a friend, who can't even access the app anymore. The shop doesn't work. I have to open the app 4 or 5 times to properly play the game without it saying 'try again later' for a few minutes at most. I feel like there should be a lot more Pokestops/gyms, or a daily bonus we can get, unlike the free shop items each day. Please sort out the errors most of all.

Love getting back out and about again after my interest in Ingress lapsed, but ugh, this app is horrendous. If you can actually log in at all it constantly freezes when capturing Pokemon, the gyms don't load or kick you out as soon as the battle starts and the tracking system is useless. I'd say we should've expected better but it IS a Niantic product after all. D-

Really enjoy the game but I hate the change they have made to the landscape colours. Living in Scotland it rains a lot. When I play and its raining the whole landscape is a depressing grey colour which is factually incorrect. All around me are lush green trees, bushes and grass. Quite the opposite to how it is reflected in Pokeman go, don't like playing therefore when it rains. Doesn't leave much playing time therefore. Hope the developers look at their depressing colour pallet.

I enjoy the collecting part of the game, but battling is a bit of a nightmare due to all the glitches and freezing. Really disappointed about the raise in price of remote raid passes, I live in a small town where there are very few players so raiding in person just doesn't happen. I will not be paying twice the amount for a remote pass so will have to just reduce the amount of raids I do.

one of the most popular games for IPhone and Android around by any margin. there are many glitches and issues that occur with every update but it's constantly being improved upon. They always add new Pokemon, raid battles field research and rewards for daily play and regular use. the downside is the game is quite repetitive and sometimes the game feels like you have to spend real money to upgrade and get items unless you regularly play it. definitely much better when the game was first released

There was so much promise for this game. Why features like trading or battling aren't included is a mystery to me, then removing the ability to track down the ones you want? So now it's just walk around in heavily populated areas and wait till things appear or your eggs hatch. I'd hoped the game would get progressively better, not progressively worse...

Never has a development team started with a great idea for a game and made continuous decisions to run it in the ground like Niantic have. Every single event and update adds more bugs and worse gameplay. Remote raids may be that final terrible decision that push people away. Take it from a 7 year player who's quitting, this game isn't worth it for the Pokémon name.

What's not to like about the idea behind it? You go catching pokemon outside. It gives gamers an excuse to actually get some exercise. What I don't like (and why I haven't given 5 stars) is because it drains your battery horrendously quickly and the servers crash a lot. I expect the server issue is just a teething problem though as nobody could have expected this level of popularity

Fun... Sorta. If you haven't played an AR game, they are fun and get you moving. And anything Pokemon is awesome. BUT this game has pretty much constantly crashed, kicked me out of gyms during raids, and otherwise made it hard to play when I'm not on wireless. Seriously. It works best when I'm not going. The Pokemon bosses and catches start to get stale after about 6 months or so as well. I'll still play because my husband does but I've largely moved on to other games for my own entertainment

Due to recent changes, the game is no longer playable for me because of living in an area with low a player base. I've been playing since day 1. Sucks to have so much time and effort get thrown in the trash because of poor decisions based on greed. This doesn't even take into account all of the bugs. Seems Niantic is going to the way of most major developers. Greed first, quality product second. Whatever.

It's awesome for all ages! You can hatch eggs, catch mysterious pokemon, battle in raids, and battle with team rocket at pokestops + if you win, you can get a chance to catch one of pokemon that you battled! I think it is one of the best games in the world. You can only level up to 40 levels but you can still play even though you finished the game. I give it a five-star review because of these reasons. Thank you Niantic for all your hard work and effort. I really appreciate all of your hard work

Was great. But lately it keeps requiring updates at which point you're locked out of the game. When I go to update it brings me to Google Play Store, but there is no option to update the App, only to install. Failed to log in, network error, lost gps, dont tresspass, you're in a car, infinite spinner, random lockups. Don't you people test this app? Think about the user experience, its terrible. I spend most of my time in the app waiting for the app to connect or otherwise get situated. Even if i leave the app and come right back. So annoying. Love hate relationships with Niantic. I've played PoGo since day 1. Even with all the bugs this game was still worth playing. Catching, getting out and exploring were just the foundation. The real reason we all play is the community. Niantic had the chance to make this the greatest game of all time. Sadly lack of communication, bugs, and money grab events may be the downfall of this game. I have gone f2p at the moment and if things don't change soon many will begin to stop playing all together.

So much of the game is based on FOMO that I couldn't keep going. Ironic, since this game basically cured my agoraphobia. Other than that, the game is very cool. The community that I've interacted with has been very positive and fun. I feel like a lot of the ticking clock mechanics introduced make it less enjoyable, but that may be an individual preference.

Quite a few bugs have been fixed over the years. The game is what you make it, you can still level up and catch many Pokemon without spending money or lots of time. It's a shame that the raid battles require you to make Pokemon Go friends, so for this reason they get 4 stars, as you can't actually Catch Them All, without P.Go friends. Also, they will request that you need to download updates without a days notice.

Good game! I had it when it first came out until I ran out of pokeballs, this game has come a long way. Kinda glitchy on Samsung devices, I've found you have to restart the game or device alot and the Poké stops don't register when I'm there. I'm level 15 and have almost 150 Pokémon. It's a good way to waiste spare time, fun to play with friends. If you like Pokémon I would highly recommend this game, it doesn't take too much data, and there is minimal adds which is always important too me. Thx

So, this has improved greatly. Though there are still some niches to be worked out, it has really moved into the right direction. I believe there are some functions that need to be looked at a bit more (battle system, raiding) as there seems to be lag issues that grant advantage/disadvantage to anyone...this one is my main concern. There are others, but one step at a time. Progress is key, and we are seeing it. Rated this a 1, it's now a 3 for me...we'll see soon enough if I can give this the 5.

My first review was 1 star due to lack of end game. I am changing it as I have checked back after about a year or so to find a lot of improvements to the end game and targets/goals for players. I still think more needs to be done on assessing Pokemon though. The ingame appraiser is vague, and while the intent to keep some mystery is understandable, the reality is that all players check IV calculators as it is too expensive to evolve pokemon which are not going to turn out well. If the hope is that players will gamble on their pokemon, then the resources needed for this need to improve.

I love this game. New things often being added it's simple enjoyable and fun to catch and train pokemon. Also nice to meet people through raiding gameplay where more than one trainer is needed. I should also add that I have contacted support a couple of times when game issues have affected my gameplay. In over 2 years of playing I have only felt the need to do this twice. Both times I have found them to be responsive and i was nicely compensated with in game things to make up for my troubles.

I get that the game has been trying to support players during this lockdown period and making SOME things more convenient, but it's obviously made other things a whole lot more annoying. I spent at least 30 balls trying to catch a Landorus after winning four Go Battle fights, and I've wasted berries and pokeballs trying to catch some Pokemon only to have them simply run away for no reason at all ... it's just frustrating playing this game.

Don't get me wrong, the game is fun and the concept of making people get outside to play and make them walk for rewards is great. But the game is pretty empty on terms of stuff to do and every other time I capture a good Pokémon the game freezes and I dong get it. Seem to spend 70% of my time restarting it or charging my phone because it drains the battery like there's no tomorrow.

Update! Recent update made Dynamax gyms freeze. Now I get a blank screen! Now level 45 but losing interest as it's getting more for groups of friends to play. As a solo player I'm missing out on lots of bonuses. Unfair system. Too much on battle/trading. I cant trade any! So can't complete some special tasks. So now 3 star instead of 5 as originally I'd put 2 yrs ago. Better now can get to level 50 n power up favourite mons. Still shame no one battles nr me as getting legendary I have no chance.

I would give it more but the augmented reality doesn't seem to work. It could just be my phone not being good enough but it takes all the fun from the game. I have a Samsung galaxy core prime model number sm-g631f. Edit: I've since got a new phone and there have been many updates. Can't complain at all, and very much enjoy the game. The AR and AR+ features both work really well, though I tend not to use them. Thanks for a good game!

Limited pokestops and 1 gym near where I live, when I go through similar size villages and they have 3 times the stops and gyms seems a bit off. Could do with reducing some stops in town and moving them rural to give us a better chance. I have been playing since launch and just hit level 38, if you live in a town you could do the same in a few weeks. Also as a suggestion could do with a ready button to finish the count down when in the raid lobby.

Downloaded this game just over a year ago, am still completely hooked. I play daily, and have walked over 2000km playing in a year. Great game, and can be completely free (in app purchases are not essential to completing that game in any way). The game has massively improved since it was first released, and has far more for.players to do each day.

I don't even know why I still play. The game is flawed over and over again. This whole train with a full party idea just made all the gyms in my town level 10 permanently. By the time i heal up its back to level 10. I dont even have pokemon over 1400 because all i find are junk. If i see a different one cant find it. Update: Returned to try again. Some things improved however most things just got worse. Mainly I hate the fact that most of the time i only get 1/2 - 1/3 of the distance.

Addictive and frustrating in equal measures. Collecting is addictive, the PvP element is great (still needs some work, though) and the Ex-Raid system is often frustrating. It's easier and a lot more enjoyable to play if you live in a city. Community Days, quests, solo raiding, special raid days, events, festivals...it's all good. Still, it's pretty much up to you how you play.

By all means, download and have a go if you have space - it's very heavy on internal storage. Have fun catching some basic Pokémon. Then delete. Don't even try and catch 'em all. It will get boring quickly, and you'll end up using up a lot of Pokeballs catching same old, same old. You'll do plenty of walking, sure, but you'll do it with your nose glued to your phone. Better off going for a hike. Look at nature.

This game is full of "scam" opportunities, Niantic often increases rates of certain pokemon and shinies (without ever telling you the rate ofcourse) only for them to either shadow change the rates or just claim it as a "bug", it's a constant occurence and not one time things, usually resulting in most of the player base spending more money to get these "increased chances". The egg system is basically a loot box system as incubators acting as the "keys" but with no information on the rates.

Fairly entertaining. The disrepair of some game features and extremely lackluster meta for battles is a major disappointment. Not a lot to draw players back and keep them playing. Collecting Pokémon & fighting Team Rocket is pretty fun, I suppose. League battles are broken so there's largely no point, especially when you consider the meta (so many useless Pokémon). Character customization is still VERY limited, even after all this time (would hair styles really be too much to ask for?)

Only complaint is the lack of stability in the app, crashing and pokestops sometimes not working, other than that its great, like living a childhood dream! Edit from 6yrs later picking it back up: I'm disappointed that it's been this long and there's still many of the same stability issues, but no shortage of attempts to monetize the game further. Not surprised, just disappointed. Still a fun game, just wish it wouldn't crash constantly.

The game itself isnt bad, but the bugs are. I love this game but can't give it more stars mainly due to the decisions Niantic make about how they want people to play it. Used to be really fun, but the game seems to constantly be plagued by connectivity issues. For the past 2 updates the game crashes when submitting pokestops. They also need to fix shiny rates. I am giving this a 4 star because sometimes when my signal is fine and everything is working it says my GPS Signal is low. This has to be my favourite mobile game! I am constantly on it!!! Massive fan of Pokémon and have been since I was a kid and now I'm nearly 30! This game enables you to explore your home villages and towns and learn whilst exploring, it's a game for all ages and it's really addictive once you get into it and understand how to play the basics. I'd recommend this game to everyone as you meet so many different people while playing. Only bad pointis if you live in rural areas there's not much to find

Great, but it could be better. One thing that really should be added to the game is some sort of communication with other players, so you can actually raid/trade with people instead of posting on facebook and crossing your fingers. Obviously you'd probably want to restrict that to 18+ players to avoid any sort of liability. One more thing that is very worth mentioning. 3,000 pokéballs for $100 is severly underwhelming. It should be at least 10,000, considering its a lot of money. Still fun tho

Remote raid passes basically doubled in price. Okay... it's not even a guaranteed catch. Updating my review since I first started playing. I love all the new raids and new features. There's so much more thats been added since I started playing back in 2016. Although it has taken a long time to get to this point, if you're looking to play this for the first time, now is a great time to do so.

Brilliant game for both casual and pro players, room for improvement and Niantic always prove that they can make the game better. Those who bought it on day one would be amazed with the differences today, and the introduction of research missions is always welcomed. I cannot wait for more to complete. Only gripe is the occasional issue during the first few weeks of updates, which are normally ironed out with frequent patches.

In recent years; the catch rate is down, Pokemon stats are down, shiny rate is down, research rewards are massively downgraded and the prices (for those who pay) have shot up. Location changing should be allowed within the game to make it fair for players to catch regional exclusive Pokemon. Plus more levels past level 40. 3 things that could make this game so much better.

My original review was made two months into the life of the game, and I disliked the likelihood of pokemon running away or the lack of tracking. Given the sheer number of additional things and fixes they applied since then I can only increase this rating to 4 stars from 1. They still release really buggy updates that often feel cash grabby, but the game is incredibly fun even ignoring the occasional paywall to playing.

Great game! Been playing it for many years now; events were fun throughout the years! I installed this game, having been a huge fan of pokémon since I was 5 years old. It's a lot better than it was, but there is still 0 consideration for rural players. PoGo has continued to improve and add some QoL features, gameplay, and social function, which help make it fun.
